derivationNote: §13's Problem Taxonomy row names seven tag dimensions (official-topic, prerequisite, difficulty, stage, complexity, common traps, expected solution) but gives no table of values for difficulty, common traps or expected solution -- unlike most data/*.json files in this corpus, the three vocabularies below are DERIVED, not transcribed verbatim. difficultyScale is a 1-5 integer scale anchored to the §2.2 competition-stage progression (OSN-K -> OSN-P -> OSN Nasional -> TOKI/IOI extension). commonTraps is derived from §2.2's OSN-K 'kompleksitas'/'tracing' competencies, §2.1's geometri-dasar family, and the §13.1 postmortem error classes. expectedSolutionClasses is derived directly from §2.1's strategi-problem-solving coverage (brute force via OSN-P's 'baseline -> optimized solution' practice model, complete search + pruning, greedy, divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming) plus graph-tree, struktur-data and geometri-dasar. See src/schema/problem-taxonomy.ts for the full per-vocabulary justification.

difficultyScale.label: Pengantar
difficultyScale.description: Latihan pengantar: satu teknik dari satu topic family, tanpa kasus tepi yang rumit. Setara level awal persiapan OSN-K.

difficultyScale.label: Dasar
difficultyScale.description: Penerapan standar satu teknik, dengan beberapa kasus tepi yang wajar. Setara persiapan OSN-K reguler.

difficultyScale.label: Menengah
difficultyScale.description: Menggabungkan dua teknik atau membutuhkan langkah modeling yang tidak langsung terlihat. Rentang khas OSN-K lanjut/OSN-P.

difficultyScale.label: Lanjut
difficultyScale.description: Membutuhkan optimasi kompleksitas yang cermat atau argumen kebenaran yang tidak trivial. Rentang khas OSN-P/OSN Nasional.

difficultyScale.label: Elite
difficultyScale.description: Kesulitan penuh setara kontes: menggabungkan beberapa teknik dengan batasan yang ketat. Rentang OSN Nasional/TOKI-IOI extension.

commonTraps.label: Off-by-one
commonTraps.description: Kesalahan batas indeks/rentang (mis. <= vs <, indeks mulai dari 0 vs 1).

commonTraps.label: Integer overflow
commonTraps.description: Hasil perhitungan melebihi jangkauan tipe integer yang dipakai, tidak memakai tipe/modular arithmetic yang tepat.

commonTraps.label: Kompleksitas berlebih
commonTraps.description: Solusi lolos secara logika tapi kompleksitasnya melebihi batas waktu (TLE); lih. §2.2 kompetensi 'kompleksitas' OSN-K.

commonTraps.label: Input kosong/degenerate
commonTraps.description: Kasus tepi seperti input kosong, satu elemen, atau graf tanpa edge tidak ditangani.

commonTraps.label: Presisi floating-point
commonTraps.description: Kesalahan pembulatan/perbandingan pada perhitungan geometri atau desimal; lih. §2.1 geometri-dasar.

commonTraps.label: Modeling keliru
commonTraps.description: Representasi soal (state, graf, invariant) salah sejak awal, bukan sekadar bug implementasi; padanan taktis dari kelas error 'modeling' §13.1.

expectedSolutionClasses.label: Brute force
expectedSolutionClasses.description: Solusi coba-semua tanpa optimasi, dipakai sebagai baseline sebelum dioptimasi; lih. §2.2 OSN-P 'baseline -> optimized solution'.

expectedSolutionClasses.label: Complete search + pruning
expectedSolutionClasses.description: Penelusuran lengkap dengan pemangkasan cabang; item pertama cakupan §2.1 strategi-problem-solving.

expectedSolutionClasses.label: Greedy
expectedSolutionClasses.description: Strategi greedy; item kedua cakupan §2.1 strategi-problem-solving.

expectedSolutionClasses.label: Divide and conquer
expectedSolutionClasses.description: Divide-and-conquer; juga muncul di cakupan §2.1 rekursi dan strategi-problem-solving.

expectedSolutionClasses.label: Dynamic programming
expectedSolutionClasses.description: Dynamic programming; item terakhir cakupan §2.1 strategi-problem-solving.

expectedSolutionClasses.label: Graph
expectedSolutionClasses.description: Algoritma graf/tree (BFS/DFS, shortest path, MST, LCA); lih. §2.1 graph-tree.

expectedSolutionClasses.label: Data structure
expectedSolutionClasses.description: Struktur data non-trivial (stack/queue, heap, DSU, Fenwick/Segment Tree); lih. §2.1 struktur-data.

expectedSolutionClasses.label: Geometry
expectedSolutionClasses.description: Geometri komputasional dasar (koordinat, jarak, convex hull); lih. §2.1 geometri-dasar.
